ValidationRule.description: This validation rule will prevent the edit operations while record got submitted.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', $Profile.Name <> 'Salesforce API Only System Integrations', NOT(ISCHANGED(Status__c)), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Submitted') )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot edit any Submitted record
